briefdescription.para: This function sends a command to ASUFW to program a USER eFUSE key.

para.verbatim: The key to be programmed can be sourced from the AKV, generated internally by the ASU using the TRNG (benign provisioning), or supplied directly by the user. USER_EFUSE_KEY_0 is always stored in black (PUF KEK encrypted) form. USER_EFUSE_KEY_1 is stored in the form selected by ParamsPtr->KeyForm (black or red). Red USER key 1 can be used by both PLM and ASU. Black USER key 1 is subsystem-exclusive; use black provisioning with the intended end use case in mind.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XAsu_ClientParams structure which holds the client input parameters.
Pointer to the XAsu_ProvisionUserEfuseParams structure which holds the USER eFUSE key provisioning input arguments.

XASU_INVALID_ARGUMENT, if any argument is invalid.
XASU_INVALID_UNIQUE_ID, if the received Queue ID is invalid.
XST_FAILURE, in case of failure.

briefdescription.para: This function sends a command to ASUFW to provision a Unique Device Endorsement (UDE) key pair.

para.verbatim: The UDE key pair (ECC NIST P-384) is generated inside the ASU so the private key is never exposed outside the ASU. The private key is encrypted with the PUF KEK and programmed into the requested eFUSE slot by the ASU (via the PLM), and a self-signed X.509 certificate over the generated public key is returned to the caller at ParamsPtr->CertBufAddr with its actual size at ParamsPtr->CertActualSizeAddr.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XAsu_ClientParams structure which holds the client input parameters.
Pointer to the XAsu_ProvisionUdeParams structure which holds the UDE key provisioning input arguments.

XST_FAILURE, in case of failure.

briefdescription.para: This function sends a command to ASUFW to generate and return the Device Provisioning Certificate (DPC) for the calling subsystem (SAS section 12.16.2).

para.verbatim: The ASU checks the internal exportable key vault for the subsystem's provisioning authentication key pair (ECC NIST P-384) and provisioning wrapping key pair (ECIES over NIST P-384). Any pair that is missing is generated with the TRNG and stored in the exportable vault. A UDE-signed X.509 certificate is generated over each public key, the DPC container (Device DNA, both certificates and a UDE signature over them) is assembled and returned to the caller at ParamsPtr->DpcBufAddr with its actual size at ParamsPtr->DpcActualSizeAddr.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XAsu_ClientParams structure which holds the client input parameters.
Pointer to the XAsu_DevProvisionCertParams structure which holds the DPC generation input arguments.
